tips.text: Cast Rebuttal when enemy spells or projectiles are about to land on you. It destroys them, and the shield and speed boost are a bonus.
Open with Solar Snare at long range. The root lasts longer the farther the orb travels, so a far hit sets up your whole combo.
Aim Radiant Barrage at where the enemy will be, such as after they are rooted or while they walk up to farm. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown.
Cast an ability just before an auto attack. Searing Brilliance then fires extra bolts with that attack.
Keep hitting the same enemy to build up Overwhelm. When they are low, it executes them, so keep poking a weakened enemy.
Cast Golden Eclipse to finish an enemy carrying many Overwhelm stacks. It needs an enemy champion with Overwhelm on them and hits every affected enemy.
Use Rebuttal on your allies' side in a fight. The shield and speed boost reach allies the nova touches.
Throw Solar Snare from long range when you can; the root lasts longer the farther the orb travels. Close-range casts only root briefly.
Cast Rebuttal when enemy projectiles are about to land on you or an ally. It destroys them, shields your team and speeds you up.
Save Rebuttal for the enemy's most dangerous projectile instead of using it on cooldown. Wait until they have thrown it.
Aim Radiant Barrage at where an enemy will stand, such as when they are rooted or last-hitting. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown.
Use an ability before you auto-attack. Searing Brilliance then adds extra bolts to that attack, so cast first and hit right after.
Keep poking the same enemy so Overwhelm builds up. Once they are low, Golden Eclipse can finish them, and Overwhelm can execute them on its own.
Follow a Solar Snare with Radiant Barrage on the rooted enemy. They can't step out of it, and your allies can join in.
Use Rebuttal as Ahri throws Charm. It destroys the kiss and gives you a shield.
Fire Solar Snare from long range to keep Ahri off you. A longer shot roots her for longer, which gives you time to follow up.
Keep poking with Radiant Barrage while Ahri's Orb of Deception is on cooldown. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown.
Hit Ahri with several abilities and attacks to build Overwhelm stacks. When her health is low, those stacks can execute her.
Cast Rebuttal as Akali throws Shuriken Flip; it destroys the shuriken and stops her dash from being recast.
Aim Solar Snare at Akali as she dashes in; the root holds her still while your damage lands. Longer range gives a longer root.
Hit Akali with Radiant Barrage when she walks up to the wave; it is a good way to poke her down.
Aim Radiant Barrage at the smoke from Twilight Shroud; area damage still hits her inside and reveals her.
Keep Rebuttal ready when Akali is at level 6; her Perfect Execution is hard to avoid otherwise and you are easy to kill when low.
Use Rebuttal when Anivia casts Flash Frost at you; it destroys the ice and gives you a shield.
Hit Anivia with Solar Snare from long range; the farther the orb travels, the longer she is rooted.
Dodge Flash Frost by sidestepping. Stay out of range of the stun at the end of its path.
Fight in lane and not near walls. Anivia's egg is hard to kill early, so kill her only when it is safe to do so.
Use Radiant Barrage on Anivia when she stands still channeling Glacial Storm.
Cast Rebuttal when Aurora's Twofold Hex or The Weirding is about to land; it destroys the projectile and shocks her back.
Aim Solar Snare at long range when Aurora walks up; the root lasts longer the farther the orb flies, so you can punish her.
Hit Aurora with Radiant Barrage from far away while she is busy with minions; the cooldown shortens when it hits her.
When Aurora vanishes with Across the Veil, do not chase blindly. Wait for her to reappear before spending Solar Snare.
Once Aurora is low, use Golden Eclipse to finish her; Overwhelm stacks make the blast hit harder.
Use Rebuttal when Cassiopeia fires Noxious Blast or Twin Fang at you. It destroys the projectile and gives you a shield.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as Petrifying Gaze goes off, so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Fire Solar Snare from long range so the root lasts longer. Cassiopeia is easy to hit while she walks around in lane.
Stay out of Miasma. It grounds you and slows you, and it stops your movement abilities.
Cast an ability, then attack. Searing Brilliance fires extra bolts on your next attack and adds Overwhelm stacks toward an execute.
Hit Cassiopeia with Radiant Barrage whenever she stands still to farm. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown.
Cast Rebuttal when Fizz throws the lure from Chum the Waters. It destroys the lure and stops his ultimate.
Aim Solar Snare at Fizz when his Playful is on cooldown. While he is balanced on his trident he can't be targeted.
Stack Overwhelm with Radiant Barrage and your attacks. Once Fizz is low, Golden Eclipse can finish him.
Keep Fizz away while his Seastone Trident glows, because his attacks hit harder for a few seconds. Use Rebuttal for a shield when he commits.
Cast Rebuttal as Malzahar throws Call of the Void or Nether Grasp; it destroys projectiles and gives you a shield.
Don't waste Solar Snare while Void Shift is up; Malzahar ignores crowd control then. Hit him once he has taken damage.
Stay away from minions marked by Malefic Visions; when they die it spreads to you.
Stand out of Call of the Void's two portals; being silenced stops your Rebuttal and Solar Snare.
Cast Radiant Barrage from long range and weave attacks in; each ability gives bonus bolts on your next attack.
Voidlings hit hard when Malzahar has built stacks of Void Swarm. Back off from them or clear them with your attacks.
Cast Rebuttal when Orianna sends the Ball at you with Command: Attack; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Aim Solar Snare at Orianna's Ball when she walks up to trade; being rooted keeps her from escaping your follow-up.
Stay away from the Ball when Orianna has Command: Shockwave; anyone near it gets pulled in and stunned.
Cast an ability before you auto-attack; Searing Brilliance adds extra bolts to the attack, and Overwhelm stacks build toward an execute.
Cast Rebuttal when Ryze throws Overload at you; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Fire Solar Snare from long range; the farther the orb travels, the longer Ryze is rooted.
Stay out of Rune Prison range, as it is a targeted spell and roots you if you carry Flux.
Land Radiant Barrage on Ryze while he is rooted or slowed, so most bolts connect.
Keep hitting Ryze with spells and attacks to build Overwhelm, then cast Golden Eclipse to finish him.
Hold Rebuttal for Sylas's Abduct or Chain Lash; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Rebuttal cannot stop Kingslayer, because it is a targeted dash. Hit him with Radiant Barrage as he comes in.
Land Solar Snare from long range for a longer root. Then follow with Radiant Barrage while he cannot move.
Keep hitting Sylas to build Overwhelm. When he is low, Golden Eclipse or one attack can execute him.
Fight him when Hijack is on cooldown. Once he has hit you with Hijack, he cannot take Golden Eclipse again for a long time.
Do not trust his health bar. Kingslayer heals him a lot when he is low, so finish him fast.
Hold Rebuttal for Twisted Fate's Wild Cards. It destroys the cards, shields you and hits him back.
Hit Twisted Fate with Solar Snare when he picks the Gold Card or comes to last-hit. A long throw roots him longer.
Poke him with Radiant Barrage whenever it's ready. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown, so you can fire it again sooner.
Watch for Destiny. When he reveals the map, play safe, because he can gate in to ambush you.
Land several hits on him to build Overwhelm, then use Golden Eclipse once his health is low.
Use Rebuttal when Viktor fires Hextech Ray or Siphon Power at you; it destroys the projectile and gives you a shield.
Fire Solar Snare from long range so the root lasts longest, then follow up while Viktor can't move.
Don't stand inside Gravity Field; leave it before it stuns you.
Cast an ability before your next attack, so Searing Brilliance adds extra bolts to it.
Move out of Arcane Storm early, since it follows whoever it damaged. Don't stay near it.
Cast Rebuttal when Yasuo's whirlwind from Steel Tempest comes at you; it destroys the projectile and gives you a shield.
Aim Solar Snare from long range; it roots for longer the farther it travels, giving you time to poke.
Expect Yasuo to put Wind Wall in front of your Radiant Barrage and Solar Snare; wait for it to fall before you throw them.
Keep hitting Yasuo with abilities and attacks to build Overwhelm, then finish him with Golden Eclipse.
Hold Rebuttal for when Yasuo dashes in with Sweeping Blade; the shield and speed help you get away.
Avoid getting knocked up by Yasuo's whirlwind, because that lets him use Last Breath on you.
Fire Solar Snare from long range at Yone. The root lasts longer the farther the orb travels, so he cannot easily escape.
Cast Rebuttal when Yone's Mortal Steel knock-up or Fate Sealed comes at you. It destroys the projectile and shields you and your allies.
Poke Yone with Radiant Barrage from long range. Hitting a champion shortens its cooldown, so you can keep firing it.
Keep hitting Yone to build Overwhelm stacks, then use Golden Eclipse once his health is low enough for the stacks to kill him.
Do not chase Yone while he is in spirit form. When it ends he snaps back to his body and repeats damage on you.
Hold Rebuttal for Zed's Razor Shuriken or Living Shadow; it destroys them and shields you.
Zed's Death Mark dash can't be destroyed by Rebuttal, so don't count on the nova to stop his ultimate.
Hit Zed with Solar Snare when he lands from a Living Shadow dash; a rooted Zed can't swap back to safety.
Use Radiant Barrage to poke Zed when he has no shadow out; his damage and mobility depend on it.
Zed's Contempt for the Weak hurts more when you are low, so keep your health up and trade carefully.
Cast Rebuttal when Cosmic Binding is coming at you; it destroys the bolt and shields you and your ally.
Stand away from walls and from other units lined up behind you, so Cosmic Binding cannot stun.
Use Solar Snare from long range on Bard; the farther the orb flies, the longer the root lasts.
Walk over Bard's shrines to destroy them, so his ally cannot take the healing.
Follow Bard through his Magical Journey portal only when you are sure it is safe; enemies can use it too.
Use Radiant Barrage on Bard whenever he walks up for chimes or last-hits; casting it also powers up your next attack.
Do not fight into Tempered Fate unless you want to be frozen in place with your enemies.
Cast Rebuttal when Braum fires Winter's Bite or Glacial Fissure at you or your carry. It destroys the projectile and shields your allies.
Don't fire Radiant Barrage or Solar Snare into a raised Unbreakable. Wait until his shield is down or aim from another side.
Leave combat before Braum and his ally land more hits on you. A fourth stack of Concussive Blows stuns you.
Stay out of the frozen ground left by Glacial Fissure, and use its long cast time to step aside.
Fire Solar Snare from long range so the root lasts longer, then follow up while Braum is stuck.
Time Rebuttal to eat Karma's Inner Flame; it destroys the projectile and shields you and your ally.
Stay out of range of Focused Resolve, or walk away so the tether breaks before it roots you. Karma uses it to disengage too.
Fire Solar Snare at long range for a longer root. Follow with Radiant Barrage while Karma can't move.
Leave the Mantra circle fast. Inner Flame with Mantra explodes there for big damage.
Keep hitting Karma so Overwhelm stacks build. Once she is low, Golden Eclipse can finish her.
Wait until Leona commits Zenith Blade, then answer with Rebuttal. It destroys the sword, so she cannot dash to you.
Fire Solar Snare from long range when you can. It roots Leona for longer, which stops her from closing in.
Back off when Leona raises Eclipse. Her armor and magic resist are high for a few seconds, then she deals damage nearby.
Stay out of Leona's reach and use Radiant Barrage from long range. Her empowered attack from Shield of Daybreak stuns you if she gets close.
Wait for Lulu to use Whimsy before you go in. Without it she has little to stop you.
Use Rebuttal when Glitterlance is coming. It destroys the bolts and shields you and your ally.
Stay behind your minions when Lulu attacks, because they can intercept Pix's bolts.
Land Solar Snare from long range. The root lasts longer the further the orb travels.
Do not clump up with your ally when Wild Growth is ready. It knocks up and slows everyone around the target.
Use Rebuttal when Lux throws Light Binding or Lucent Singularity at you; it destroys both and hits her back.
Rebuttal cannot stop Final Spark. When you see its red line, step to the side.
Fire Solar Snare from long range at Lux so the root lasts longer, then follow up with Radiant Barrage.
Cast an ability before you auto-attack Lux; Searing Brilliance then adds extra bolts to that attack.
Stay spread out from your partner so Lux cannot hit you both with one Light Binding.
Aim Solar Snare at Milio from long range when he steps up to kick or poke. The longer the orb travels, the longer he stays rooted.
Cast Rebuttal when Milio kicks Ultra Mega Fire Kick at you. It destroys the fireball and shields you and your ally.
Milio is fragile when he is alone. Look for him when his allies are away, then land Solar Snare and follow up with Radiant Barrage.
Watch for his Breath of Life before you commit your root. It cleanses crowd control from his team.
Use Rebuttal when Nami's Aqua Prison or Tidal Wave is flying at you; it destroys the projectile and shields you and your ally.
Fire Solar Snare from far away so the root lasts longer. Nami has little to stop you if she is rooted, so follow up with Radiant Barrage.
Stay out of Nami's Aqua Prison range, and move sideways when she casts it. If she misses, her long cooldown gives you a window to attack.
Skip fights against a champion with Tidecaller's Blessing active; it fades quickly, so wait it out.
Keep hitting Nami and her partner with abilities and attacks to build Overwhelm. Then use Golden Eclipse to finish a low-health enemy.
Step out of the path of Tidal Wave; it travels slowly and you can see it coming.
Keep Rebuttal ready for Dredge Line. It destroys the anchor, so Nautilus cannot pull you in.
Stay far from Nautilus and poke with Radiant Barrage. His hook has long range, so also stay behind your minions.
Fire Solar Snare at him when he engages. It roots him, and the field around it slows him.
Hold still when Riptide goes off next to you until its waves end. Running early takes you into the later waves.
Hit his shield with Radiant Barrage when he turns on Titan's Wrath. Its area damage from attacks is big.
Hold Rebuttal when Nautilus goes for the hook. Depth Charge is a projectile too, so it is useful against his ultimate chase.
Hold Solar Snare for when Pantheon jumps in; a rooted Pantheon is easy to kill. Shoot from far away to root him longer.
Cast Rebuttal when Pantheon throws Comet Spear; it destroys the spear and shields you and your ally.
Don't fire into Aegis Assault from the front; he takes no damage from that side. Wait it out or hit him from behind.
Stay near your ally when Pantheon is up; Shield Vault stuns, so keep Rebuttal ready to cover them.
Keep your health up. A thrown Comet Spear hits hard on low targets, so step back when you are low.
Move away when you see Grand Starfall; it gives a warning before he lands.
Save Rebuttal for Pyke's Bone Skewer or Phantom Undertow; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Hit Pyke with Solar Snare when he comes for a pull. Rooted, he can't dash in, and the field leaves him slowed.
Keep Radiant Barrage on Pyke to chip him down. He can only heal that damage back once he is out of your sight.
Stay away from low-health allies; Pyke can execute them with Death From Below, and you could be next.
When sharks circle under your feet, Pyke is hiding nearby. Step back from your allies and be ready to answer his dash.
Cast Rebuttal when Last Embrace is flying at you. It destroys the projectile, so you dodge the root and hit back.
Hit Senna with Solar Snare from long range for a longer root, then follow with Radiant Barrage while she is stuck.
Senna out-ranges you as she collects Mist. Trade on your own terms, and do not stand still where Piercing Darkness can slow you.
Chain abilities into a basic attack so Searing Brilliance fires extra bolts. Build Overwhelm stacks on Senna so Golden Eclipse can finish her.
Use Rebuttal when Seraphine fires Beat Drop or High Note; it destroys the projectile and shields you.
Don't get slowed before Beat Drop lands. Slowed targets get rooted, and rooted ones get stunned.
Stay out of Encore's long reach; if it hits you, you are charmed and easy to hit.
Land Solar Snare from far away for a longer root, then follow with Radiant Barrage.
Wait for Sona to commit Crescendo, then answer with Rebuttal to destroy it before it lands.
Fire Solar Snare from far away to root Sona for longer; she is fragile and cannot escape easily.
Use Radiant Barrage on Sona when she stands still; hitting a champion shortens its wait.
Kill Sona first in fights; she heals and shields her team with Aria of Perseverance.
Hold Rebuttal until Thresh starts casting Death Sentence. It destroys his scythe and shields you.
Hit Thresh with Solar Snare when he walks up for a hook. It roots him and the field slows him.
Stay behind minions so Death Sentence stops on them. It hits the first unit in its path.
Use Radiant Barrage to poke Thresh when he steps forward. Its cooldown drops when it hits a champion.
If you get caught by Flay or The Box, use Rebuttal to take a shield and speed up your escape.
